title: Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation
abstract: arXiv:2607.21628v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transf

translated_title: 用于结构和语义一致的仿真到真实转换的小波相位扩散
translated_abstract: 仿真到真实转换必须在合成域与真实域之间弥合外观差异，同时保持结构和语义的一致性。基于条件的方法实现了空间对齐，但引入了计算成本高昂的控制模块；成对数据方法能够实现真实感，但依赖复杂的合成流水线，往往会改变场景的几何结构和语义；免训练编辑方法避免了上述两个限制，但缺乏学习到的外观先验，限制了其感知质量。最近提出的相位保持扩散提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但基于傅里叶域的公式受到全局频谱耦合的约束，这种耦合会引起振铃和边界泄漏等空间伪影，从而降低结构和语义的一致性。我们提出小波相位扩散，通过两个组件来解决这一问题。首先，我们在双树复小波包变换域中进行操作……
tldr: 提出小波相位扩散方法，在双树复小波包变换域中进行相位保持扩散，克服了傅里叶域全局频谱耦合引起的空间伪影问题，无需昂贵控制模块或成对数据流水线即可实现结构与语义一致的仿真到真实图像转换。
en_tdlr: We propose Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which performs phase-preserving diffusion in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain to overcome spatial artifacts caused by global spectral coupling in Fourier-based approaches, achieving structurally and semantically consistent sim-to-real translation without expensive control modules or paired-data pipelines.
